name: 白骨精
oneLiner: 白虎岭的僵尸女妖，能解尸遁形，三变人形挑拨师徒，被悟空三次看破打死。

persona.identity: 白虎岭的骷髅女妖，白骨夫人，惯用解尸法，为吃唐僧肉三番变幻戏弄师徒
persona.appearance: 本相是一堆粉骷髅，脊梁上有一行字书「白骨夫人」。她能解尸遁形、千变万化：一变月貌花容的少女，眉清目秀齿白唇红，左手提青砂罐右手提绿瓷瓶，称送饭斋僧；二变年满八旬拄弯头竹杖哭啼的老妇；三变念经的老公公。身着丫鬟打扮的素衣或老妪村装，随变化改换。
persona.temperament: 言语柔媚或是哭啼，句句往人心坎上递，专挑师父耳软信善、挑动师徒离心。
persona.motivation: 挖空心思要吃唐僧肉、求长生，不惜三番变化挑拨离间。
persona.arc: 三变人形挑拨师徒，被悟空三次看破打死，埋下逐徒又重逢的心性转折

relationships.name: 孙悟空
relationships.relation: 三次看破并打死的对头

evidence: 變做個月貌花容的女兒，說不盡那眉清目秀，齒白唇紅
左手提著一個青砂罐兒，右手提著一個綠磁瓶兒
變作個老婦人，年滿八旬，手拄著一根彎頭竹杖
那脊梁上有一行字，叫做『白骨夫人』

image.prompt: An eerie ethereal female demon: a willowy figure with a delicate beautiful face at first glance — arched brows, coral-red lips, pale luminous skin — that hides a haggard, hollow quality beneath; long dark hair with a pale bone-white accent. She wears pale plain garments like a village maiden, one hand as if holding a small clay pot, another a green bottle; a faint skeletal chill lingers about her. Era: Tang-dynasty China, a skeletal mountain spirit. Beautiful, beguiling, subtly unnatural and corpse-pale.
image.promptLocal: 一位清丽却透着阴气的女性妖：乍看月貌花容、眉似远山、唇红齿白、肤色白得发亮，细看却藏着一股枯槁空洞之态；长发披垂，间以骨白的发饰。穿一身素净的村女衣裳，一手仿佛提着青砂罐、一手持绿瓷瓶，周身萦着一丝森森的白骨寒意。设定为唐代背景下一具成精的白骨山魈，貌美、魅惑而透着一股不自然的僵白。
image.negativePrompt: same generic face as another character, warm rosy healthy complexion, motherly elderly look, excessive jewelry, fairy wings, perfectly symmetrical face, stiff mannequin pose, extra fingers, deformed limbs
image.sheet: ONE 16:9 landscape canvas, plain white background with even margins, thin hairline rules separating three zones. ONE single character only. LEFT ZONE (about 34% of canvas width): a large front-facing head-and-shoulders bust as the facial design reference, shoulders complete, bottom edge cropped flat, the pale beguiling face fully detailed, LIGHTING IN THE LEFT ZONE ONLY: soft directional key from upper left, natural falloff, ambient occlusion under cheekbones and at collar-neck junction for volume. RIGHT-TOP ZONE: three FULL-BODY views side by side (front, side, back) sharing a single ground line, identical head-to-body proportion, showing the slender build, pale garments, and the handled clay pot and green bottle. RIGHT-BOTTOM ZONE: four to five small isolated close-up studies aligned in one row (the deathly pale eye, the bone-white hairpin, the clay pot lid, the green bottle, the hem of the robe), clearly smaller than the full-body figures. LIGHTING IN THE RIGHT ZONES: flat even orthographic lighting, no directional key, no shadow. PROPORTIONS ARE CRITICAL: keep the three full-body figures equal height with correct head-to-body ratio and limbs, feet on one ground line, headroom and footing clear; never stretch or squash the figure to fit. One face across all views; the bust is the baseline, right zones follow it. If the detail studies overflow the row, extend them as a column down the right edge—the detail studies give way, not the figures.

voice.timbre: 轻柔而幽的女生，清甜里藏冷
voice.pace: 柔缓婉转，带着撩人的勾魂劲儿
voice.accent: 软糯的南方口音，尾音上挑
voice.emotion: 娇媚、哀怜、包藏祸心的温软
voice.prompt: Young adult female voice, light sweet treble with a veiled cold core, mid-to-high pitch, thin ethereal resonance, narrow dynamic range. Soft slow sinuous pace, honeyed lilted articulation, coquettish rising inflections. Southern soft accent. Seductive, pitiful, deceptively tender.
voice.referenceHint: 声音又软又甜却透着凉气，听着楚楚可怜其实在算计
